display: May be rendered or labelled anywhere: RCE/RVIE listings, PDFs, Excel exports, historical rows. Implicit on every entry — never write it in a catalog file, the generator adds it.
emit: The facturador may put this code on the wire to SUNAT.
select: The issuance UI may offer this code in a picker. Implies `emit`.
download: A CPE of this type is retrievable from SUNAT's consultacpe service (XML/PDF/CDR).
void: May appear in a Comunicación de Baja (RA).
retired: SUNAT withdrew this code. Never emit it; still display it so historical rows render. Mutually exclusive with `emit`.
internal: A Perunio-internal marker that never reaches the wire. The entry must carry `props.wireEquivalent` naming the code sent instead.
on-boleta: Valid when the nota references a boleta (Cat.01 code 03).
on-factura: Valid when the nota references a factura (Cat.01 code 01).
full-reversal: This nota motivo reverses the whole referenced document.
line-selection: This nota motivo credits only the lines the user selects.
gre-weight: May be used as the unidad de medida for a guía de remisión's gross weight.
